entities.name: PMID:10749617
observations: Annals of Surgery 2000 study of 67 patients undergoing potentially curative hepatic resection for hepatocellular carcinoma; preoperative serum IL-10 and IL-6 were measured by ELISA, with 27 healthy donors as controls.
High preoperative serum IL-10 was associated with worse disease-free survival on univariate analysis and was an independent predictor of post-resection outcome on multivariate analysis.
Preoperative serum IL-6 was not significantly correlated with disease-free survival, although cytokine levels decreased after resection.
